data.name: Esmerolda
data.gender_notes: Esmerolda is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Old Germanic words ‘Esme’ meaning ‘exalted’ and ‘hild’ meaning ‘battle’ or ‘strife’. This name signifies a noble and powerful woman. The name Esmerolda carries the meaning “Exalted Lady” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Esmerolda usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted lady and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the inner strength and resilience of a woman.
data.etymology: Esmerolda belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Exalted Lady.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Esmerolda total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

data.spiritual_significance: Esmerolda carries a deep spiritual importance, reminding us of the strength and determination found within each of us as we battle through the trials and hardships of life. It is a name that is a reminder to stand strong, exalted in our faith, and never backing down from the spiritual battles that we face every day. The name is a reminder of the power and courage that comes from God, and that with His guidance, we can overcome any obstacle and emerge victorious.
